description: Add or change a purchase price. Required: supplier_id, key, and a price as unit_price (minor units) or price_chf. Optional: name, description, unit, vat_rate, offer_item_key (links it to our own position so the margin can be read off), active, sort.

key.description: Unique key of the purchase price within the supplier; existing key is updated

offer_item_key.description: Key of our own price list line, to read off the margin

price_chf.description: Purchase price as text in main units, e.g. '450' or "1'234.56"

name: upsert_supplier_item
